input.query: SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE is_active) AS active_users, SUM(card_spend_eur) AS total_card_spend, SUM(card_spend_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE is_active),0) AS spend_per_active_user, SUM(n_card_txns) AS card_txns, SUM(n_card_txns) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE is_active),0) AS txns_per_active_user FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING (user_id) WHERE u.country = 'Romania' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
